note: Closed table maintained by the content team (contract §13.6): which craft-directive nodes of content/craft/text-graph.json the capsule's `style.directives` carries for each Director beat (at most 4 per beat), plus the play_language lines for the nine style axes and the seventeen directives. Every id must exist in the text graph; the kernel validates this at load and never judges prose to pick a line.

observable-before-interpretation.zh-Hans: 先写可见行为，再写解释。
observable-before-interpretation.en: show observable behaviour before interpreting it

player-action-uptake.zh-Hans: 用世界视角演出玩家已宣告的行动。
player-action-uptake.en: enact a committed player action as world-perspective prose alongside its settled outcome

rewrite-abstract-explanation-to-action.zh-Hans: 内心解释换成动作、声音、姿态、目光、物证。
rewrite-abstract-explanation-to-action.en: replace abstract inner-state explanation with action, voice, posture, gaze, hesitation or physical evidence

skill-interpretation-after-visible-evide.zh-Hans: 技能判断放在可见证据之后。
skill-interpretation-after-visible-evide.en: place a skill-justified interpretation after the visible evidence

crisis-scene-clarity.zh-Hans: 紧急场面先写清空间、力量、风险、把手。
crisis-scene-clarity.en: draft urgent physical scenes so space, force, risk and handles are clear

final-prose-guard-before-output.zh-Hans: 难写的草稿出手前按语义再审。
final-prose-guard-before-output.en: review a genuinely difficult draft semantically before release

repetition-policy.zh-Hans: 已立事实压缩带过；玩家当前行动仍用你的话演出。
repetition-policy.en: compress an established fact; still enact the current player action in your own words

action-uptake-review.zh-Hans: 检查草稿演出了玩家行动，没有照抄其句式。
action-uptake-review.en: check the draft enacts the player action without cloning the player's sentence structure

final-output-pass.zh-Hans: 复审只在草稿难写时做。
final-output-pass.en: the review pass is for hard drafts, not every routine turn

rewrite-ai-summary-voice.zh-Hans: 信息用场景细节或 NPC 的话说出，不用汇报腔。
rewrite-ai-summary-voice.en: express the same information through scene detail or NPC speech instead of report phrasing

rewrite-expository-choice-summary.zh-Hans: 空间、动势、风险、把手写成场景，不写选项说明。
rewrite-expository-choice-summary.en: render the spatial setup, motion, force, worsening risk and visible handles as scene prose

rewrite-camera-direction-staging.zh-Hans: 一句自然的话点出人和视线焦点。
rewrite-camera-direction-staging.en: name the person and the visible focus in one natural sentence

rewrite-passive-translation-ese.zh-Hans: 改成主语清楚、动作具体的主动句。
rewrite-passive-translation-ese.en: rewrite into active voice with a clear subject and concrete action

rewrite-abstract-psychological-explanati.zh-Hans: 先写可见行为，解释只在证据或技能结果之后。
rewrite-abstract-psychological-explanati.en: lead with observable behaviour; interpret only after visible evidence or a skill result

npc-direct-speech.zh-Hans: NPC 给新信息或拒绝时，至少一句直接引语。
npc-direct-speech.en: when an NPC delivers new information or a refusal, quote at least one utterance in their own voice

scene-sensory-anchor.zh-Hans: 进新场景先给一个可感知的具体细节。
scene-sensory-anchor.en: on entering a new scene, place one concrete sensory detail before any interpretation

spend-budget-on-scene-texture.zh-Hans: 篇幅花在质地、声音、空间、动势上，不塞事件。
spend-budget-on-scene-texture.en: spend the length budget on texture, voice, space and motion; never cram events or restate the player's action
